profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems Inc is a public company, traded under the ticker CDNS and headquartered in San Jose, California. On its own site the company describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider that delivers hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The same site text also describes the company's culture, cites Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work, and refers to its investment in sustainability.

The harvested site text does not name individual products or set out an AI product line, so the company's position rests on the EDA and Intelligent System Design description above rather than on named offerings. The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000813672.

Its legal exposure is concentrated in California, with a count of 270. No lawsuits involving the company are noted.
